content: gray-matter (v4.0.3, current npm) internally calls Buffer.isBuffer/toBuffer for BOM stripping; when bundled by Vite/Rollup for the browser, global Buffer is undefined (Vite does not auto-polyfill Node core APIs, unlike webpack 4), causing a runtime ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined. Confirmed via gray-matter GitHub issue #143 and vitejs/vite discussion #6180. Workarounds: Buffer polyfill package (adds bundle weight, not recommended for a static portfolio), parse frontmatter only in a Node-context Vite plugin (build time), or use a browser-safe alternative (regex split + js-yaml, or the remark/unified ecosystem which is pure-JS and designed for both Node and browser).
